summary: 8-phase plan for whole-mode extraction from commands/task.md into six context/patterns files with imperative READ pointers at the Mode Detection dispatch table. Action Verb Categories discrepancy resolved explicitly as MERGE-AND-DROP (union merged into step 3.2 inline, standalone table deleted) because today's effective keyword set is already the union and option (b) would make 7 of ~19 keywords conditional on a READ. Named a previously-unflagged hazard: grep '^## ' reports a fence-interior '## Task Review' decoy inside Review Mode, so naive boundary detection silently truncates 209 lines; Phase 1 produces a fence-validated anchor map and extraction runs bottom-up. Phase 7 is the mandated index-entries.json line_count phase (generate-context-line-counts.sh --write then --check). Phase 8 is a full-tier per-mode executability audit plus byte-ledger reconciliation and the required before/after measurement table. No parallelism: phases 2-6 all mutate one file, stated explicitly rather than manufacturing unsafe waves.
